title: Yummy Polish Herring Curry
description: A peppery, dense monsoon-inspired Polish dish that blends shio-cured herring with Thai red curry paste, all made without onion or garlic.
instructions: Pat the shio-cured herring dry with paper towels.
Heat the vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the oil and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, black pepper, smoked paprika, ginger, and lemongrass, stirring until well blended.
Gently fold in the julienned carrots and let the sauce simmer for 3 minutes to soften.
Add the herring pieces to the saucepan and simmer for 4 minutes until the herring is heated through.
Stir in chopped parsley and adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Serve the curry hot over a bed of steamed rice or boiled potatoes, garnishing with extra parsley if desired.
